planning_model: generated by aimdk_grasp.planning_model from aimdk_description (AgibotTech/agibot_x2_urdf@575cc6b, v1.3.0 body + v1.4.0 left OmniHand)

imported_from.description: x2_left planning assets of the original X2 grasp workspace

mount_calibration: The hand is the AimDK SDK hand (palm_mount and thumb_mount: legacy), as the operator confirmed on the robot: R_palm at the SDK palm position (0, 0, -0.046) from left_wrist_roll_link in the pipeline tool orientation, the four fingers and the thumb on their SDK mounts. That is the hand of the GraspGen-X gripper description and of the hand collision spheres (identical per link to the SDK cover). The official model puts the palm 3 mm further out, its fingers 0.53 degrees about the wrist axis away and its thumb 75 degrees off; it does not match the hardware
collision_spheres: imported unchanged except the shoulder roll links, re-expressed into the official link frames (the frame origin differs, the geometry does not); the torso cover is refit on the official torso mesh by aimdk_grasp.torso_cover
hand_cover_placement: official_mesh.origin and official_mesh.scale were added to the imported hand_collision_cover.json in review: they record the visual placement the generated model gives each covered link, so a description that moves or scales the same STL is refused until the cover is regenerated (the imported file's sha256 above documents the upstream artifact before this extension)

official_mesh_coverage_mm.description: max vertex distance outside the link's spheres, official collision mesh (body) or visual mesh (hand); negative = covered

right_arm: seven revolute joints; locked from feedback at planning
dummy: wrist roll geometry is the official OmniHand one; the v1.3.0 dummy hand is not part of the model
self_collision_exclusions: mechanical tree distance <= 2; no cross-arm blanket exclusions
left_arm_limits: intersected with the MC-enforced arm_limits of the robot configuration named by planning_model.arm_limits_config (aimdk_x2_grasp)
lower_body: requires measured fixed-body collision scene in torso coordinates
